title: On Maintaining the road for thirty years
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：maintain　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 maintain 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the foreman ① maintained the road for thirty years twice over, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② maintains the road for thirty years year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ maintain the road for thirty years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ maintained the road for thirty years before — a line in the sheet for May 1969 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Maintaining the road for thirty years twice over, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ maintain that the record was complete year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Maintain that the record was complete at once and never mention it again.

By 1982 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ maintains that the record was complete twice over every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ maintained the road for thirty years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To maintain the road for thirty years, my mother said in 1987, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody maintains the road for thirty years year after year again and somebody must maintain the road for thirty years twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 维持（一般过去式 maintained the road for thirty years：1975 年工头头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 维持（一般现在 maintains the road for thirty years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 维持（不定式 to maintain the road for thirty years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 维持（过去完成时 had maintained the road for thirty years：1969 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 维持（动名词 maintaining the road for thirty years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 坚称（maintain that the record was complete：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去坚称坚称那份记载是完整的）
G. v. 坚称（maintain that the record was complete：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 维持（后段两处：新来的工人照例 maintains that the record was complete，而母亲又一次 maintained the road for thirty years）

answers.why: maintain 意为“维持”，1975 年工头来回两遍维持把那条路养护了三十年，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 maintained。
maintain 意为“维持”，自那以后工头年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 maintains。
maintain 意为“维持”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯维持把那条路养护了三十年”，此处为不定式 to maintain the road for thirty years。
maintain 意为“维持”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1982 年之前就有人维持过，故用过去完成时 had maintained。
maintain 意为“维持”，工头说“维持把那条路养护了三十年这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 maintaining the road for thirty years 作主语。
maintain 意为“坚称”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去坚称坚称那份记载是完整的”，should ever 之后用原形 maintain that the record was complete。
maintain 意为“坚称”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻坚称坚称那份记载是完整的（maintain that the record was complete at once），以后再也不要提起。
maintain 意为“维持”，新来的工人每个班次都照例坚称坚称那份记载是完整的，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 maintains。
maintain 意为“维持”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍维持把那条路养护了三十年，用一般过去式 maintained 叙述。
maintain 意为“维持”，结尾那句是母亲 1987 年的话：要维持把那条路养护了三十年，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 maintain 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the foreman maintained the road for thirty years twice over, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman maintains the road for thirty years year after year whenever the site asks.
Maintaining the road for thirty years twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever maintain that the record was complete year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site maintains that the record was complete twice over every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother maintained the road for thirty years again, and the site remembered that half.
